import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    b = data[1]
    a = data[2:2 + n]
    cuts = []
    balance = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            balance += 1
        else:
            balance -= 1
        if balance == 0 and i != n - 1:
            cuts.append(i + 1)  # 1-indexed position
    count = 0
    m = len(cuts)
    if m > 1:
        costs = [abs(a[p] - a[p - 1]) for p in cuts]
        costs.sort()
        spent = 0
        for cost in costs:
            if spent + cost <= b:
                spent += cost
                count += 1
            else:
                break
    elif m == 1:
        p = cuts[0]
        if abs(a[p] - a[p - 1]) >= b:
            count = 1
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
